title: असली नाम
logline: Mausi holds the photograph, knows whose hand it is and chooses to cover for her girl. Kiran refuses the cover: she strips the chooda off her own arm, shows the scar to the man who promised to kill its owner, and hands him Mausi's keys. He pours the powder away and gives both women to the police. At the chowki she gives her birth name.
language_note: Hinglish: Hindi in Devanagari, English words in Latin script, in the same line.

characters.name: किरण (Kiran)
characters.role: LEAD. The bureau's vanishing bride. Played 'Sneha' on the wedding night, 'Pooja' at wedding six. Born Tulsi.
characters.look: Indian woman, 27, about 5 ft 3, slight and wiry. Wheat-brown skin, oval face, straight dark brows, large kajal-lined eyes, closed watchful mouth. Black hair, centre parting with a thin line of sindoor, low bun, two loose strands at the temples. Small round red bindi, thin plain gold ring in the LEFT nostril, small gold studs, short black-bead mangalsutra. Period 2: plain ash-grey cotton salwar-kurta, three-quarter sleeves ending a hand's width above the chooda, plain grey dupatta over the left shoulder, flat black sandals. Block henna on both hands (solid palm disc, fingertips dipped). Red-and-ivory chooda on both forearms until b3, when she takes the LEFT stack off on screen; from b3a to the end the LEFT forearm is bare and shows the crescent scar (story_locks.scar), with faint pressure lines where the bangles sat; the RIGHT stack stays on to the last frame.
characters.voice_note: Female, late 20s, alto with a dry edge. Small-city Madhya Pradesh Hindi with everyday English (phone, police, reception). Her own register all episode: lower, flat, quick, short sentences, तुम to Aditya; आप to Mausi, and with Mausi she sounds younger. Under pressure she gets quieter and more exact, never shrill. Lies come easily; true things come after a pause. At the chowki the first two names are habit, the third is the truth.

characters.name: आदित्य (Aditya)
characters.role: The groom. Mohit's elder brother, a pharmacist who spent fourteen months making himself the bureau's mark.
characters.look: Indian man, 33, about 6 ft, tall and narrow, slight stoop. Light-brown skin, long clean-shaven face, neat black hair with a left side parting, rimless rectangular glasses in every shot. Plain cream cotton-silk wedding kurta, band collar, sleeves folded back once, creased from the night; cream churidar; tan leather sandals. Brass key on a doubled red thread outside the kurta at mid-chest, in every shot to the last frame. Plain steel watch, brown strap, left wrist.
characters.voice_note: Male, early 30s, light baritone, soft-spoken. Educated small-city Hindi in full sentences: तुम to Kiran, आप to Mausi, साहब to the police. Even and unhurried, like a man reading out a prescription. Under pressure he slows and drops in volume; never shouts. The one place the voice may catch is his brother's name (l15).

characters.name: शकुन मौसी (Shakun Mausi)
characters.role: Owner of the bureau. Runs the brides; the only mother Kiran has had.
characters.look: Indian woman, 56, about 5 ft 2, broad and heavy-shouldered. Brown skin, round face, heavy-lidded shrewd eyes, paan-reddened lips, large round maroon bindi, small gold nose stud, grey-streaked hair oiled into a tight bun. Starched bottle-green cotton saree with a narrow mustard border, mustard blouse, thin gold chain, a dozen green glass bangles on each wrist, rubber slippers. NO key ring at her left hip in this episode: Kiran lifted it in s1a02 b5.
characters.voice_note: Female, mid 50s, low, warm and grainy, a paan-chewer's unhurried mouth. Bundelkhand-side Hindi, Hindi-heavy, trade English only (party, shutter). Endearments (बेटा, मेरी बच्ची, दामाद जी). She never raises her voice: the colder the moment, the softer and slower she gets. Fully voiced, never a whisper.

characters.name: बिल्लू (Billu)
characters.role: Mausi's driver, lookout and the bride's 'brother'.
characters.look: Indian man, 30, about 5 ft 7, wiry and restless. Brown skin, sharp jaw, patchy stubble, black hair gelled straight back. Faded blue denim jacket with sleeves pushed up over a black round-neck T-shirt, dark jeans, grey-white sneakers. Wooden toothpick in the right corner of his mouth; car key on a steel ring hooked on his right index finger. No weapon.
characters.voice_note: Male, about 30, light tenor, fast, a little nasal, talks round a toothpick. Small-town street Hindi. To Mausi quick and obedient. When surprised he goes loud for one line, then looks to Mausi.

characters.name: छोटी (Chhoti)
characters.role: The next bride in training. Her first wedding is booked for tomorrow.
characters.look: Adult woman, 19, about 5 ft 1, slight, light-brown skin, wide curious eyes. One long black braid pulled forward over her right shoulder. Plain mustard-yellow cotton kurta with short sleeves, white salwar, a plain white dupatta (D-007 direction 14), rubber slippers. Two thin green glass bangles on the right wrist; both forearms plainly unmarked. A phone in a plain pink cover in her right hand. Henna half finished: LEFT palm disc and dipped fingertips, RIGHT hand bare.
characters.voice_note: Female, 19, bright and quick by nature; here frightened, so the voice goes very small and the giggle is gone. Calls Kiran दीदी.

characters.name: सिपाही (Constable)
characters.role: A voice and a khaki sleeve: at the bureau shutter in b8, at the chowki desk in b10.
characters.look: Never a face. A plain khaki sleeve with no readable badge or crest, a broad brown hand, a steel-capped pen, the edge of a shoulder. Invented force.
characters.voice_note: Male, about 50, flat and tired, a clerk's Hindi, one word at a time. He has written a thousand names.

location: Shubh Lagan Marriage Bureau and Beauty Parlour, front room, with the grey steel shutter down: pink walls, the mirror wall with bare bulbs and two black parlour chairs on the left, Mausi's wooden desk and chair at the back facing the shutter with the grey steel cashbox on it, the low wooden cot along the right wall, the plastic marigold curtain behind the desk to the back room and its alley door, the featureless mannequin in red in the corner. Lit by tube light and mirror bulbs only. Then a small police chowki of an invented force: one wooden desk with a green cloth top, an open register, a steel tumbler, a wooden bench against a pale-yellow wall, a barred window, an open door to a bright yard. No crest, flag, portrait or readable text anywhere.
time_of_day: Day 2, late April: about 9:30 am at the bureau (shutter down from b1a), before noon at the chowki (flat daylight).

beats.action: Opens inside the last frame of s1a02. Set-up 1 (insert, held from the cliffhanger): the creased 4x6 print in Mausi's hand, green glass bangles at her wrist; the one approved photograph image (D-007 direction 15). l01 plays over set-up 2: Mausi, seated at her desk, lowers the print a little; her eyes on Kiran's face, then down to the LEFT hand Kiran holds behind her back. She does not say it. Set-up 3, l02: Kiran single, standing in front of the desk, left hand behind her back; her right hand at her side, Mausi's key ring closed in her right fist against her thigh (as in the last frame of s1a02; she shifts it to her little finger before b3). Aditya stands beside Kiran, Billu soft behind Mausi's chair: each seen only in singles; no more than two faces in any frame.

lines.speaker: mausi
lines.text: [calm] मंदिर वाली party... तो आप मोहित के भाई हैं।

lines.speaker: kiran
lines.text: [quietly] आपको पता था, मौसी? कि वो नहीं रहा?

beats.action: Mausi's silence is the answer. Set-up 1, held through the silence: Mausi single, the smile still in place, eyes on Kiran; she does not answer. l03 plays over set-up 2: Billu single, crossed from behind Mausi's chair to the shutter on her word, toothpick in his mouth, his hand reaching up to the shutter's pull strap; Mausi's voice over him.

lines.speaker: mausi
lines.text: [calm] बिल्लू, shutter गिरा दे, बेटा।

beats.action: Set-up 1, through the silence: the room from the cot side, two figures in frame at most, after the shutter has come down (sound only); the daylight is gone and the room is tube light and mirror bulbs, the mannequin's blank face catching the bulbs. l04 plays over set-up 2: Aditya single, stepping up to the desk, glasses, key on its red thread, the paper fold not yet out.

lines.speaker: aditya
lines.text: [calm] रेखा कहाँ है, मौसी जी? जली कलाई वाली?

beats.action: Mausi has never heard the name. Set-up 1, through the silence: Mausi single, her eyes going to Kiran for one beat; she has understood the lie and what it was for. l05 over set-up 2: Mausi back to Aditya, the smile wider, backing it without a blink. Set-up 3 (insert) under the second half of l05 ('...भाग गई, दामाद जी।'): Mausi lays the print face down on the desk beside the cashbox and puts her hand flat on it. l06 over set-up 4: Mausi to Kiran, low, a two-shot over Mausi's shoulder onto Kiran's face. She does not reach for Kiran's wrist.

lines.speaker: mausi
lines.text: [chuckles] रेखा? वो तो साल भर पहले भाग गई, दामाद जी।

lines.speaker: mausi
lines.text: [quietly] तू बस मेरे पास रह, मेरी बच्ची।

beats.action: Kiran refuses the cover. l07 over set-up 1: Kiran single, to Mausi. Then the silence, two set-ups. Set-up 2: close on Kiran's LEFT forearm brought out from behind her back and held over the desk edge, her right fingers sliding the first ivory bangle off over the left hand; the key ring, shifted from her right fist to her right little finger to free those fingers, stays below frame. Set-up 3 (insert): the desk top by the grey cashbox, red and ivory bangles lying where they dropped one by one, the last one still rolling to a stop (one still; the roll is sound). The forearm is not yet turned to camera.

lines.speaker: kiran
lines.text: [calm] मेरे लिए झूठ मत बोलिए, मौसी।

beats.action: Set-up 1, through the silence (insert): her bare LEFT forearm turned outward toward Aditya, palm down, the crescent scar on the outer side about three fingers above the wrist bone, pale, slightly shiny, faint pressure lines where the cuff sat; the RIGHT forearm, still in its red cuff, at the edge of frame. Must match the hand sheet and the photograph (story_locks.scar). l08 over set-up 2: Kiran single, looking at Aditya. l09 over set-up 3: Aditya single, eyes going from her arm to her face; he does not move.

lines.speaker: kiran
lines.text: [quietly] रेखा कोई नहीं है। मोहित की दुल्हन मैं थी।

lines.speaker: aditya
lines.text: [calm] तुम थीं। पूरी रात मेरे सामने बैठी थीं।

beats.action: Fourteen months, and the hand is a foot away. Set-up 1, through the silence (insert): Aditya's long fingers taking the small white paper fold from his right kurta pocket, still half full, held between two fingers against the cream kurta, the key on its red thread above it. l10 over set-up 2: Mausi has risen and stepped round the desk in front of Kiran, a two-shot of Mausi's face and Aditya's shoulder; she bargains like the trader she is. l11 over set-up 3: Billu single by the shutter, half a step forward, waiting for a word. Nobody answers him.

lines.speaker: mausi
lines.text: [calm] पुड़िया रख दीजिए, दामाद जी। दाम बोलिए। लड़की मेरी है।

lines.speaker: billu
lines.text: [nervous] मौसी? कुछ करूँ?

beats.action: Nobody moves. Set-up 1, through the silence: the three of them held in one composition with only two faces readable (Mausi and Aditya; Kiran a shoulder behind Mausi). l12 over set-up 2 (insert), Kiran's voice over her hand: Kiran's right hand, still in its red cuff, comes up past Mausi's arm and opens: Mausi's steel ring of about eight keys hanging from it, held out to Aditya. On the cut out of the insert he takes the keys in his free hand (the chink is sound); the fold stays in the other.

lines.speaker: kiran
lines.text: [calm] हिसाब तुम्हारे phone में है। किताब भी ले जाओ।

beats.action: Set-up 1, through the silence (insert): Mausi's hand, green bangles, going to her LEFT hip where the keys have always hung, and finding only starched green cotton. l13 over set-up 2: Mausi single, turning to Kiran. l14 over set-up 3: Kiran single, meeting her eyes. Mausi says only 'तूने...?' (D-007 direction 10); no appeal to the years since fourteen.

lines.speaker: mausi
lines.text: [quietly] तूने...?

lines.speaker: kiran
lines.text: [calm] हाँ मौसी। आपने ही सिखाया है।

beats.action: Aditya asks the hand for one thing. Hand state: the fold stays in one hand; he has dropped Mausi's key ring into his kurta pocket with the other (the chink is sound, not a shot), so that hand is free. l15 over set-up 1 (insert then single): that free hand picks the face-down print up off the desk and slips it into the same pocket; then Aditya single, looking at her bare forearm, not her face. l16 and l17 over set-up 2: Kiran single, eyes down, giving him something small and true. Set-up 3, held through the closing silence: Aditya single; behind the glasses he takes it in. He did not go to the reception.

lines.speaker: aditya
lines.text: [quietly] एक बात बताओगी? उस रात मोहित ने क्या कहा था?

lines.speaker: kiran
lines.text: [hesitant] घबराया हुआ था। दूध उसने ख़ुद माँगा था।

lines.speaker: kiran
lines.text: [quietly] और बोला, भैया reception पे आएँगे।

beats.action: Outside: an engine, a fist on the shutter (sound). Set-up 1, through the silence: the grey shutter from inside, bars of hard white daylight cutting through its slats across the pink wall and floor. l18 over set-up 2: Billu single at the shutter, one eye to a gap in the slats, a bar of white daylight across his face, the toothpick still in: he has seen the vehicle outside. He goes for the marigold curtain after the line (sound, b7a).

lines.speaker: billu
lines.text: [nervous] मौसी! Police की गाड़ी!

beats.action: Billu's exit is sound only (curtain rattle, back door bang); he is not seen again. Set-up 1, held through the whole silence: Mausi single, sitting back down at her desk, folding a paan leaf in her fingers. l19 over set-up 2: Chhoti, who came through the curtain at the noise, sitting frozen on the edge of the cot along the right wall, pink phone in her right hand. l20 over set-up 3: Kiran single, crossing to the cot. Chhoti goes out through the curtain after l20 (sound only: the curtain rattle at the top of b8).

lines.speaker: chhoti
lines.text: [whispers] दीदी... ये police है?

lines.speaker: kiran
lines.text: [calm] Phone बंद कर, छोटी। घर जा। [quietly] तू आज यहाँ थी ही नहीं।

beats.action: Two set-ups through the silence. Set-up 1 (about 1.2 s): the shutter up (the rattle is sound), daylight flooding the floor; at the frame edge a khaki sleeve and a broad brown hand still on the shutter's bottom bar; no face, no badge. Set-up 2 (insert, about 1.8 s): Aditya's hand tips the paper fold over; white powder falls onto the bureau's floor tiles. l21 over set-up 3: Aditya, having stepped back from Kiran, speaks toward the khaki sleeve at the door, Mausi's key ring (from his pocket) held out in his hand toward it, a two-shot with Kiran soft in the background. He says nothing for her and nothing against her.

lines.speaker: aditya
lines.text: [calm] साहब, दो नाम लिखने हैं।

beats.action: Set-up 1, through the silence (one image): the thick red cloth ledger from the cashbox, unlocked by the khaki hand with Mausi's ring, and the key ring on top of it (the khaki hand took the ring from Aditya at the end of b8), carried out under a khaki arm into the daylight. Set-up 2: Mausi walked toward the door behind them, passing Kiran; Mausi's hand tucks a loose strand of Kiran's hair behind her ear. l22 over set-up 2, a two-shot, Mausi's face and Kiran's profile. Mausi goes out behind her own ledger.

lines.speaker: mausi
lines.text: [quietly] खाना खा लेना, बेटा।

beats.action: Flat late-morning daylight. Set-up 1, through the silence: the green cloth desk top, the open register (page text an overlay or blurred), a khaki sleeve and a hand with a steel-capped pen at the edge of frame. l23 over set-up 1. l24 over set-up 2: Kiran single, seated across the desk, grey kurta, eyes on the register.

lines.speaker: constable
lines.text: [flatly] नाम?

lines.speaker: kiran
lines.text: [flatly] स्नेहा।

beats.action: The pen waits. Set-up 1, through the silence (insert): the pen's steel cap held still above the register, not writing. l25 over set-up 2: Kiran single, a little closer than in b10.

lines.speaker: kiran
lines.text: [quietly] किरण।

beats.action: The pen waits again. Set-up 1, through the silence (insert): the same pen, still not writing. l26 over set-up 2: Kiran single, closer still, looking up from the register for the first time; she holds that set-up to the end of the line. The pen touching the page on her last word is sound only (the scratch), not a separate still.

lines.speaker: kiran
lines.text: [calm] तुलसी। माँ ने तुलसी रखा था।

beats.action: Final image, no line, two set-ups. Set-up 1 (about 2.5 s): her bare LEFT forearm lying palm down on the green cloth desk, the crescent scar in plain daylight, beside the RIGHT forearm still in its red-and-ivory cuff; henna on both hands. Set-up 2 (about 2.5 s): from behind her, in the open doorway to the bright yard, Aditya (cream kurta, glasses, the brass key on its red thread) sets the creased photograph down on the wooden bench, face up, and walks out into the sun; Kiran is a soft shoulder in the foreground, her face not in frame. Cut to black on his empty doorway.

sfx_notes: Bed, bureau, shutter down (b1 to b7a): the hum of a tube light, a faint buzz from the mirror bulbs, a ceiling fan turning slowly. Muffled morning street sound outside the shutter, thin and distant: no voices.
b1: open on the room tone already running, no sting. Green glass bangles chink once as Mausi lowers the print.
b1a into b2: the shutter rattles down under b2's opening silence, long and metallic, ending in a hard clang on the floor. The outside sound drops by half.
b2a: a dry tap of the print laid face down on the wooden desk.

b3: the bangles coming off: each one clicks against the next as it slides over her hand, then drops onto the wooden desk, one by one, the last one rolling and settling. Leave it exposed, no music under it.
b4: paper crinkle as the fold comes out of the pocket. Mausi's slippers on the floor as she comes round the desk.
b5: the key ring chinks once as Kiran's hand opens. Mausi's sound all series has been these keys at her hip; here they are heard in Kiran's hand.
b5a: green bangles, a soft rustle of starched cotton as Mausi's hand finds nothing at her hip.
b6: the key ring chinks once going into Aditya's kurta pocket at the top of the beat, before l15. Duck the bed a little under l16 and l17; nothing else.
b7: an engine pulls up outside and idles; a fist on the shutter, three blows, the steel booming. White light through the slats is a picture change, not a sound.
b7a: the plastic marigold curtain rattles as Billu goes through; a back door bangs once, off. A paan leaf folded (tiny crackle). The cot creaks as Chhoti sits.

b8: the marigold curtain rattles again as Chhoti goes; the shutter rattles up, loud; daylight street air floods in (birds, a distant horn, no voices). A faint dry patter of powder on tile, very close. A soft chink of keys as the khaki hand takes the ring from Aditya at the end of l21.
b8a: footsteps on tile going out; green bangles once as Mausi's hand touches Kiran's hair. Duck everything under l22.

Bed, chowki (b10 to b11): a ceiling fan, a crow outside, a distant handpump or yard sound. No voices, no radio. A pen cap clicks before l23; the pen scratches once on the register on the last word of l26.
b10, b10a, b10b: keep the bed low and dry under the three names so each word is clear. Under l26 drop the bed almost to nothing.
b11: Aditya's sandals on the floor, the faint tap of the photograph on the wooden bench, his steps going out into the yard and fading. Fan and crow continue to the cut.
music_note: Almost none. No score under b1 to b3: room tone and objects carry it. A single low sustained string note enters under b3a (the scar) and holds very quietly through b6, cut dead by the fist on the shutter in b7. Nothing under b7 to b8a. Silence under the three names at the chowki. One quiet, unresolved resolution cue (harmonium or a single bowed string, sparse) begins on the photograph touching the bench in b11 and carries over the cut to black. The ending is a release, not a sting.
ending_question: आदित्य photo bench पर छोड़कर चला गया: उसने तुलसी को माफ़ कर दिया, या बस उसका पीछा छोड़ दिया?
writer_notes: Sources: content/series1/bible.json revision 2, beat_outlines.s1a03, story_locks and production_locks, read with docs/decisions.md D-003, D-005, D-007 (binding, governs where it differs), D-008, D-013, D-014.

Beat ids: the bible's b1 to b8, b10 and b11 are kept (b9 was folded into b8 by D-005 change 9, so there is no b9). Eight letter beats were added (b1a, b2a, b3a, b5a, b7a, b8a, b10a, b10b), following bible id_convention.beats ('an added beat takes a letter'). Each letter beat exists only because the schema allows silence before or after a beat's lines, not between them, and the story needs a held silence there: Mausi not answering (b1a), her glance at Kiran (b2a), the turned forearm (b3a), the empty hip (b5a), the room emptying (b7a), the ledger going out (b8a), and the pen waiting twice (b10a, b10b). No story content was added.

Length: dialogue is about 760 characters, emotion tags and the space after each tag excluded, counted by hand in Unicode code points with spaces and punctuation. That is under the D-007 direction 1 measure of about 1,050 and was not padded. Spoken targets total 87.3 s for 26 lines after critic round 1 (was 85.6; the six shortest turns raised to Gate 0b's measured floor) (about 8.9 characters a second, set slower than the proofs' rate because Gate 0b measured eleven_v4 takes 20 to 60 per cent over target). Speaker changes: 20 at 0.3 s, 6.0 s. Silences: 31.9 s across 18 beats (b3a raised from 0.8 to 2.0 s for the scar). target_total_seconds 125.2 (87.3 + 31.9 + 6.0). The 0.3 s gaps that fall across a silent beat are counted on top of that silence, so the sum leans slightly long; kept as the conservative figure. Projected running time from Gate 0b's overrun is above this target and may pass 135 s. Trim order if measured takes run long: protect b3, b3a, b8 and b11 (the scar, the powder and the last image); trim first the b2 silence from 1.5 to 1.0 s, then b10a and b10b from 1.5 to 1.2 s each, then the b6 closing silence from 1.8 to 1.2 s, then shorten l04 to '[calm] रेखा कहाँ है, मौसी जी?'. Do not touch any locked or default line. Not measured; no shell was available to count or parse.

Bible and D-007 defaults used as written: l05 is the D-005 default with one change, 'दो साल पहले' made 'साल भर पहले' (critic round 1): Mohit's temple wedding was about fourteen months ago (s1e01 b8), so 'two years ago' would put Rekha's flight before the photograph and Aditya knows the date. 'रेखा? वो तो साल भर पहले भाग गई, दामाद जी।' is the same length and does the same job; the line is not in locked_lines. S1 errata: update story_locks.rekha to match. l06 built on 'तू बस मेरे पास रह।' with 'मेरी बच्ची' added for Mausi's register, l10 'पुड़िया रख दीजिए, दामाद जी। दाम बोलिए। लड़की मेरी है।' (D-007 direction 11: kept), l13 'तूने...?' (D-007 direction 10), l14 'हाँ मौसी। आपने ही सिखाया है।' (s1a03 only, kept_apart_in_the_two_finales), l22 'खाना खा लेना' with बेटा added, l23 to l26 the chowki names.
l07 takes the D-007 advisory wording 'मेरे लिए झूठ मत बोलिए, मौसी।' rather than the bible's 'आपको झूठ बोलने की ज़रूरत नहीं, मौसी।': shorter, and it still means 'do not lie for me', not an accusation.

Kept apart from branch B: Mausi never reaches for Kiran's wrist and never offers the hand (b2a, b4); 'the boy turned out weak' is not said; the fact that Mausi knew comes out through Kiran's question (l02) and Mausi's silence (b1a); there is no 'since you were fourteen' appeal (D-007 direction 10).
